story: E005-F005-S001: Implement CLI detection and installation infrastructure
story_description: As a first-time Blaze user, I need the app to automatically detect which agentic coding CLIs are already installed and offer to install missing ones during onboarding so that I can start using the app without manual CLI setup.
task_description: Implement the CLIInstallationService Swift actor that provides async methods for detecting installed CLIs, checking dependencies, and executing installation commands. The service must be thread-safe, cancellable, and emit progress events.
atom_description: Create the CLIInstallationService actor in Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Services/CLIInstallationService.swift that orchestrates CLI detection and installation. This actor is the core business logic layer for the CLI setup feature, coordinating between CLIType definitions, shell command execution, and progress reporting.
problem_statement: Blaze needs to detect and install multiple agentic coding CLIs (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, etc.) during onboarding. Each CLI has different detection methods (checking PATH, version commands), dependencies (Node.js, Python, Rust), and installation mechanisms (npm, pip, brew, shell scripts). Without a centralized service actor, this logic would be scattered across view models and views, making it untestable, non-thread-safe, and difficult to maintain. The service must handle concurrent detection of multiple CLIs, sequential installation with progress tracking, cancellation support, and graceful error recovery.

api_contracts: CLIInstallationService.detectAllCLIs() async -> [CLIDetectionResult] - Scans for all known CLIs
CLIInstallationService.detectCLI(type: CLIType) async -> CLIDetectionResult - Detects single CLI
CLIInstallationService.installCLI(type: CLIType) async throws - Installs single CLI
event_contracts: InstallProgress event emitted on progressPublisher when installation step changes
InstallProgress.step transitions: preparing -> downloading -> installing -> verifying -> complete/failed
Progress events include cli field identifying which CLI is being installed
Progress events include progress field (0.0 to 1.0) for determinate progress bars
edge_cases: Edge case 1: CLI executable exists but version command fails - return isInstalled=true with version=nil
Edge case 2: CLI partially installed (executable exists but broken) - detect as installed, installation will overwrite
Edge case 3: Network timeout during npm/pip install - throw CLIInstallError.timeout with 5-minute threshold
Edge case 4: User cancels during download phase - check isCancelled flag and throw .cancelled
Edge case 5: Permission denied during global npm install - throw CLIInstallError.permissionDenied
Edge case 6: Homebrew not installed for brew formula - throw CLIInstallError.dependencyMissing(.homebrew)
Edge case 7: Multiple CLIs with shared dependency (Node.js) - check dependency once and cache result
Edge case 8: PATH does not include Homebrew paths - search common Homebrew locations directly
Edge case 9: Version string in unexpected format - capture raw string, do not parse
Edge case 10: Empty types array passed to installMultipleCLIs - return empty report immediately
failure_modes: FM-001: Process.run() throws if executable not found - Mitigation: Catch and convert to CLIInstallError.notFound
FM-002: Shell command hangs indefinitely - Mitigation: Use Task.sleep with timeout and terminate process
FM-003: Race condition on isCancelled flag - Mitigation: Actor isolation ensures serial access
FM-004: Memory leak from Process not terminated - Mitigation: Always call terminate() in defer block
FM-005: progressSubject subscriber not cleaned up - Mitigation: Use AnyPublisher wrapper, no strong refs
FM-006: CLIType.installCommand returns .shell with malicious script - Mitigation: Only execute known commands from CLIType enum
rollback_plan: Delete Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Services/CLIInstallationService.swift file. Remove imports from dependent files (CLISetupViewModel). Revert to manual CLI setup instructions in onboarding. Installed CLIs remain on system (no uninstall). No data migration required as service has no persistent storage.

notes: This atom is the core business logic for CLI detection and installation. The actor model ensures thread-safety for concurrent detection operations. Progress reporting uses Combine publisher pattern for SwiftUI integration.

risks: Risk 1: Shell command injection if CLIType.installCommand is compromised
Risk 2: Process hangs indefinitely blocking actor
Risk 3: Installation succeeds but PATH not updated in current shell environment
Risk 4: Concurrent installations of same CLI cause corruption
Risk 5: Rate limiting or network issues cause installation failures
mitigations: Mitigation 1: Only execute commands from hardcoded CLIType enum, never user input
Mitigation 2: Implement timeout with Task.sleep and Process.terminate() fallback
Mitigation 3: Re-detect CLI after install to verify, warn user to restart app if needed
Mitigation 4: Actor isolation ensures serial installation, queue multiple requests
Mitigation 5: Add retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures
risk_register.blast_radius: Medium - Installation failures affect only onboarding flow, not core app functionality. Failed CLI can be installed manually. No data loss possible.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If service implementation blocked or buggy, show manual installation instructions with copy-paste commands. Link to official CLI installation docs. User can complete setup manually and re-run detection.

persistence: No persistent storage - service is stateless between runs
